origin.source_heading: LEVEL demonstration: Local Evidence, Verifiable Engineering Lifecycle
origin.interpretation: CORA defines a proposed game and proof method, not a completed game or a full narrative bible.

goal.claim: A new player can complete an original six-level 2D platform story, overcome three bosses, observe persistent checkpoints, receive accessible feedback and trace gameplay and assets to accepted requirements and independently witnessed execution.

story.setting: Ramecittà, a town where the Factory of Hours distributes time to everyone
story.premise: The clock apprentice Nilo discovers that six hours have been locked away; reclaiming them requires restoring the factory without taking time from anyone else.
story.theme: Time is shared; power over time must be accountable.
story.conflict: The Director of Hours hoards the six hours, transforming citizens' routines into rigid schedules.
story_arc: A clock that runs only for the powerful
Uncovering the cost of stolen minutes
Giving citizens control of their time
story.ending: The factory belongs to its citizens; Nilo learns to repair systems, not to control people.
nonclaims: No existing published franchise or protected character assets are licensed by this draft.
Creative originality and trademark clearance require human review.

characters.name: Nilo
characters.motivation: restore six missing hours without becoming a new timekeeper
characters.silhouette: small oval cap, triangular scarf, round watch
characters.interaction: runs, jumps, carries a winding key

characters.name: Tica
characters.motivation: record fair changes to the factory

characters.name: Direttore delle Ore
characters.interaction: three-phase final encounter, review before development

levels.title: Cortile delle Lancette
levels.story: first missing hour; learn the controls

levels.title: Canali dei Minuti
levels.story: Cross the Canals, repair the Custode pendulum during safe windows and return the second hour.
mechanics: time-dependent moving bridge that carries player
Custode telegraph, grounded strike, recovery repair on E, CP-02 retry
levels.exit: defeat Custode by two player-caused repairs, restoring second hour only on VICTORY

acceptance_oracles.claim: LV-01 to LV-02 requires a completed first level and real KeyN; LV-02 traversable
moving bridge carries player across dynamic physical support
two signed currents affect physical velocity
CP-02 persists independently and rejects forged/cross-level records
hour two remains unavailable until physical Custode victory
Custode telegraph precedes physical strike; two repair key edges during distinct recovery windows win; two actual hits defeat; retry is CP-02 and pause is frozen

levels.title: Archivio delle Ombre
levels.story: read who lost access to time

levels.title: Bosco delle Campane
levels.story: make decisions with Tica and Perno

gameplay.seed_engine: native HTML canvas with ES modules; no external gameplay engine
gameplay.security: no backend, no cookies, no telemetry, no requested permissions, no outbound requests
accessibility_targets: manual contrast and screen-reader assessment before release

game_feel.scope: LV-01 source mechanics candidate, not validated enjoyment
game_feel.input_contract: One rising jump edge, held input for variable height, no repeat without release

input_continuity.owner: web/main.mjs + web/core.mjs; no second event engine
input_continuity.event_model: native keyboard events delivered to fixed tick once; sampled held-state is separately preserved
input_continuity.transient_short_press: preserved across event-loop frames until one simulation step
input_continuity.native_browser_witness: tests/browser-e2e.py must run against exact PR SHA

visual_scene.scope: LV-01 original pixel art and first-hour narrative only; no full-game visual approval

gameplay.current_scope: LV-01 and LV-02 playable source candidates; first boss Custode implemented. Four levels and two bosses are design only; no independent playtest.

lv02.transition: KeyN only after LV-01 COMPLETED, or valid CP-02 reload

slice.goal: one playable prologue with movement, camera, collisions, checkpoint persistence, HUD and finish

acceptance_oracles.claim: moving right advances Nilo and scrolls the camera
player does not fall through platforms on collision
activated checkpoint survives reload and resumes without invalid values
pause freezes movement, restart resets only transient state
visible HUD and instructions support an external user completing the prologue
a deliberately broken checkpoint write fails the negative oracle

allowed: create PR1 seed files and source-only tests in authorized NILO repository
local browser/manual play with operator consent
not_allowed: claim legal compliance or accessibility certification

risks.title: browser, host, OS and hardware not attested
independent code review and required checks unverified

market_beta_vision.genre: original 2D narrative precision platformer with pixel-art presentation
market_beta_vision.promise: Recover six shared hours through six complete acts and three fair, legible bosses; each restored hour visibly repairs the factory and changes the city.
player_trajectory: master reversible jumps and fair checkpoints
meet allies with visually and narratively distinct roles
recover the hour and see an immediate world-state consequence
finish six levels and three bosses
reach a coherent ending and credits

art_direction.scope: candidate original procedural 480x270 pixel canvas in LV-01 only
art_direction.hero: Nilo: cap, scarf, face, watch and leg-cycle silhouette
art_direction.guide: Tica: clockwork bird visible in scene
art_direction.ally: Perno: static clockwork technician by first checkpoint
art_direction.future_levels: design-only; new palette and mechanic per chapter must be independently approved

experience_targets.recovery_seconds: candidate <=1.5 after death when gameplay exists
experience_targets.readability: in-game instructions remain legible at supported viewport size
experience_targets.accessibility: keyboard and reduced motion first; touch not implemented, screen reader equivalent unresolved

commercial_comparators.title: Celeste
commercial_comparators.principle: precision input, readable retries, player challenge/assist options

commercial_comparators.title: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope
commercial_comparators.principle: coherent readable pixel silhouettes, multi-plane backgrounds and character progression

commercial_comparators.title: Hollow Knight
commercial_comparators.principle: environmental storytelling, distinguishable regions and memorable characters

market_beta_vision.beta_boundary: Six actual playable levels and three bosses plus G_BETA_RELEASE independent evidence; current LV-01 pixel-art proposal does not satisfy the commercial vision.

delivery.notes: Source CI may prove build, local HTTP and Chrome static artifact parity; actual Codespaces forwarded access and remote Render deploy remain independent external witnesses.
